package.name: Pixelforge
package.description: A pixel-art RPG world for Game Mode that you walk around in. Pick a setting, like a cozy village or a sci-fi colony, then explore, talk to NPCs, and let the Game Master narrate. Install it, then choose Pixelforge as the Experience when creating a Game Mode chat.
